keyword: what hand does engagement ring go on

ai_overview.markdown:
An engagement ring is traditionally worn on the fourth finger (the ring finger) of the [left hand](https://4cs.gia.edu/en-us/blog/how-to-wear-engagement-ring-wedding-band/) in North America and much of the Western world.[[1]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/what-hand-does-wedding-ring-go-on/)[[2]](https://4cs.gia.edu/en-us/blog/how-to-wear-engagement-ring-wedding-band/)

### Cultural Differences

- **Western Countries:** In the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, and France, the left ring finger is standard.
- **Other Countries:** In countries like Germany, India, Russia, Norway, and Spain, the right hand is more common for engagement and wedding rings.[[1]](https://4cs.gia.edu/en-us/blog/how-to-wear-engagement-ring-wedding-band/)[[2]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/what-hand-does-wedding-ring-go-on/)[[3]](https://www.pragnell.co.uk/guides/bridal/engagement-ring-finger)

### How to Wear It After the Wedding

- **Stacking:** After the wedding ceremony, most people wear both the engagement ring and the wedding band on the same finger.
- **Placement:** The wedding band usually goes on first so it sits closest to your heart, with the engagement ring stacked right above it.[[1]](https://www.reddit.com/r/WeddingRingAdvice/comments/1nhel6k/what_hand_does_an_engagement_ring_go_on/)[[2]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/en-ca/guides/what-hand-does-wedding-ring-go-on/)
